mandate8e_doctor_autonomy.details: 0 disabled buttons on primary CTA actions. Doctor warranty discounts up to 100% supported without master-password lockouts. Debounced autosave and instant 1-click presets.

mandate8n_solo_doctor_sovereignty.details: Physical persons have isInnRequired=false. Zero forced citizen INN or passport hurdles during checkout.

mandate8am_single_primary_cta.details: Exactly ONE Primary CTA (#0d9488 / var(--teal)) per visible view (Checkout: 'Принять оплату', Shift close: 'Закрыть смену и напечатать Z-отчёт' / 'Снять Z-отчёт'). Secondary actions styled with neutral border.

mandate8x_8ap_clinical_language.details: Clean Russian clinical terminology. No raw Soviet codes (54-FZ -> 'Кассовый чек' / 'Касса', 804n -> 'Прейскурант услуг', 043/у -> 'Медицинская карта приёма', ФФД 1.2 -> 'Кассовый чек').

zero_float_drift_integer_kopecks.details: Financial calculations run strictly in integer kopecks (amountKopecks: bigint / integer) via rubToKopecks/kopecksToRub.

apple_hig_touch_ergonomics.details: Native Mobile Bottom Sheet (rounded-t-[24px], Drag Handle 36x5px, min-h-[44px] touch targets, Natural Thumb Zone floating bottom bar, 0px horizontal scroll).

idempotency_and_transactional_resilience.details: Full support for clientMutationId / Idempotency-Key header, advisory locks against double submission, and PostgreSQL transactions.

defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.defect: On 390px mobile screens, the Z-report primary CTA button in the footer overflowed when displayed alongside 'X-отчёт' and 'Отмена', resulting in truncated text with an ellipsis: 'Закрыть смену и напе...' / 'Закрыть смену (...)'.
defectsIdentifiedAndFixed.fix: Introduced responsive label: 'Закрыть смену и напечатать Z-отчётСнять Z-отчёт' with truncate. Preserved test suite invariant while completely eliminating clipping on mobile devices.
